digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and datetime/timezone handling
propositions: Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families must be enabled in the global linter configuration once all 6 existing diagnostics across src/rebar and tests are resolved.

Integer epoch timestamps must be converted to UTC using `datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(created, tz=datetime.timezone.utc)` and timezone-less persisted strings must be assigned UTC using `.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)`.

Security-pin cadence logic must obtain an aware current instant with an explicit timezone argument, convert to host timezone, and extract the local date to preserve calendar-date semantics while passing DTZ005 compliance.
Tests must prove UTC timestamp clustering is invariant across at least two distinct TZ environment values on platforms supporting time.tzset(), with explicit skip on unsupported platforms.
Production code under src/rebar must not use the literal `datetime.UTC` token; only `datetime.timezone.utc` is permitted for py310 compatibility.
Ruff security selector `S` must remain absent and Semgrep configuration files (.semgrep.yml, .semgrep.yaml, .semgrep/) must not exist in the repository.
